Visitor customizes figure and figcaption elements

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitFigcaption(NodeContext ctx, String text) {
                return new VisitResult.Custom(String.format("*%s*", text));
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<article><h1>Article Title</h1><p>Introduction paragraph.</p><figure><img src=\"diagram.png\" alt=\"System architecture diagram\"><figcaption>Figure 1: System Architecture</figcaption></figure><p>Explanation of the figure.</p></article>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
